description: This file defines the SelectedDisplayField entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_selected_display_field' database table and uses Doctrine ORM annotations. The class manages the relationship between display fields and reports, with getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayField
classes.description: An entity class representing the selected display fields associated with reports, including relationships with DisplayField and Report entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the selected display field.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Assigns a DisplayField entity to this selected display field.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Assigns a Report entity to this selected display field.
